title: Pro Football: 2026-27 NFC #1 Seed
description:
This market will resolve according to the team that receives the number 1 seed in the National Football Conference (NFC) for the 2027 NFL Playoffs, based on the final standings of the 2026-27 NFL regular season.

If at any point it becomes impossible for the listed team to receive the number 1 seed in the NFC for the 2027 NFL Playoffs, the corresponding market will resolve to "No".

If multiple teams are tied for the best regular season record in the NFC, this market will resolve in favor of the team that is officially awarded the number 1 seed under the NFL's tie-breaking procedures, available here: https://www.nfl.com/standings/tie-breaking-procedures.

If the 2026-27 NFL regular season is cancelled, postponed after January 24, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, or the number 1 seed in the NFC has not been officially determined within that timeframe, this market will resolve to "Other".

The resolution source for this market will be official information from the NFL (https://www.nfl.com/); however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

title: Pro Football: 2026-27 Scrimmage Yards Leader
description:
This market will resolve in favor of the player that finishes the 2026-27 NFL regular season with the most scrimmage yards (rushing yards plus receiving yards).

In the event of a tie, this market will resolve in favor of the tied player with more scrimmage touchdowns (rushing touchdowns plus receiving touchdowns) during the 2026-27 NFL regular season. title: Fantasy Football: 2026-27 TE Points Per Game (PPR)
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the listed player's average fantasy points per game during the 2026-27 NFL regular season (Weeks 1 through 18) equals or exceeds the listed number under standard PPR (points-per-reception) scoring per the default scoring of ESPN Fantasy Sports. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

Average fantasy points per game is the player's total PPR fantasy points for the 2026-27 NFL regular season divided by the number of regular season games in which the player appeared, as reported by ESPN Fantasy Sports. Only regular season games count; postseason (playoff) games are excluded. There is no minimum number of games played. If the listed player does not appear in any 2026-27 NFL regular season game, this market will resolve to "No".

If the 2026-27 NFL regular season is cancelled, postponed past January 26, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, or the per-game averages cannot be determined within this timeframe, this market will resolve to "No".

The resolution source will be official season statistics as reported by ESPN Fantasy Sports (https://www.espn.com/fantasy/).

title: Pro Football: 2026-27 Worst Regular Season Record
description:
This market will resolve according to the team that finishes the 2026-27 NFL regular season with the worst regular season record (the lowest winning percentage among all 32 teams).

If at any point it becomes impossible for the listed team to finish the 2026-27 NFL regular season with the worst regular season record, the corresponding market will resolve to "No".

If two or more teams finish tied for the worst regular season record, this market will resolve in favor of the tied team that is assigned the earliest selection position in the 2027 NFL Draft under the NFL's draft order tie-breaking procedures (strength of schedule, then the applicable divisional or conference tiebreakers), before accounting for any traded or forfeited selections.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from the NFL (https://www.nfl.com/); however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

title: Pro Football: 2026-27 Last Unbeaten Team
description:
This market will resolve according to the team that remains without a single loss the longest during the 2026-27 NFL regular season.

Ties do not count as losses.

If at any point it becomes impossible for the listed team to be the last team remaining without a loss, the corresponding market will resolve to "No".

If multiple teams suffer their first loss on the same day, or if multiple teams finish the 2026-27 NFL regular season without a loss, this market will resolve in favor of the tied team that played the most games before recording its first loss, regardless of the number of ties recorded by those teams.

If a tie still persists, this market will resolve in favor of the tied team with the greater strength of victory in all games, and then the tied team with the greater strength of schedule in all games, as those terms are used in the NFL's official tie-breaking procedures (https://www.nfl.com/standings/tie-breaking-procedures). If a tie still persists, this market will resolve in favor of the tied team whose full team name, as listed in this market, comes first alphabetically. The "Other" option will not be considered in these tie-breaks.

If the 2026-27 NFL regular season is cancelled, postponed after January 24, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, or the team that remained without a loss the longest cannot be determined within that timeframe, this market will resolve to "Other".

The resolution source for this market will be official information from the NFL (https://www.nfl.com/); however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

title: Fantasy Football: 2026 Polymarket Fantasy League Winner
description:
This market will resolve according to the team that wins the 2026 Polymarket Fantasy League championship. The Polymarket Fantasy League is an ESPN Fantasy Football league (https://fantasy.espn.com/football/league?leagueId=447376974). The champion is the team that wins the league's playoff championship matchup, scheduled for Week 17 of the 2026 NFL season (December 31, 2026 to January 4, 2027), as determined by the league's settings on ESPN Fantasy. If the championship matchup ends in a tie, the champion will be the team that ESPN Fantasy declares the winner under the league's playoff tiebreaker settings.

If at any point it becomes impossible for a listed team to win the 2026 Polymarket Fantasy League championship per the league's settings on ESPN Fantasy (e.g., they fail to qualify for or are eliminated from the playoffs), the corresponding market will resolve to "No".

Listed teams refer to the teams in this league as named on ESPN Fantasy at market creation. If a team is renamed, the corresponding market will refer to that same team under its new name.

The "Other" option resolves to "Yes" only if none of the listed teams is declared the winner of the 2026 Polymarket Fantasy League championship. If the league is cancelled, or there is otherwise no single champion declared by January 19, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

The primary resolution source will be official information from the league's page on ESPN Fantasy; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from the NFL; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.
